articles.title: Exclusive: Latino leaders push Beshear on Texas' race for governor
articles.dek: Dozens of Latino lawmakers and leaders are pressuring Kentucky Gov. Andy Beshear , who chairs the Democratic Governors Association, to invest $10 million in the Texas governor's race, according to a letter to Beshear that Axios obtained. Texas state Rep. Gina Hinojosa , who polls suggest is running a strong challenge to Gov. Greg Abbott (R), is trying to become Texas' first Latino governor. Beshear must decide soon how to invest the DGA's cash in the 36 states with governor's races in November. Why it matters: Beshear is considering a presidential run in 2028 . articles.title: Dem governors weighing White House face the DeSantis dilemma
articles.dek: Top aides for Florida Gov. Ron DeSantis ' failed 2024 presidential campaign have a warning for Democratic governors eyeing a 2028 run: Don't wait too long after November's midterms to jump into the race.
